author: CC
prose: A reseal door on the tester. It censuses standing, runs every expired proof, lands the seals, and stages them. Greens finish silently. A red lands in the operator inbox with its stderr tail, which is the one place CC or Akien enter. The trouble tickets already self-clear on the next inspector pass once the seal matches. Fire it from a git pre-commit hook over the staged files, not from the beat, so it stays event-driven and never becomes a poller. Order: the import-closure fingerprint first, the hook second, or a one-line edit runs 30 proofs and a commit takes seven minutes. A hook is a host-seam, so it needs the apply recipe and re-runnable verify the commons demands for one. Akien 2026-09-06: 'i agree about your optimizations all the way thru.'
